## Read SPSS Data File {.unnumbered}


### Description

Reads an SPSS <code>.sav</code> file, converts user-missing values to <code>NA</code>,
and removes all labels. Optionally applies any active SPSS filter variable.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>get_spss_data(file_path, check_filter = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="file_path">file_path</code></td>
<td>
Character string. Path to the <code>.sav</code> file.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="check_filter">check_filter</code></td>
<td>
Logical. If <code>TRUE</code>, checks for and applies any
active SPSS filter variable. Default is <code>TRUE</code>.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
Logical. If <code>TRUE</code>, prints diagnostic information.
Default is <code>FALSE</code>.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

A tibble with numeric values and no SPSS labels.
